name: Kpopping Online Wallpapers
description: Search K-pop idols and groups on kpopping.com from the Wallpapers tab: ranked name matches with one-click alternatives, recent searches, infinite scroll through every post, Hot / Newest / Most liked order, and orientation/resolution (SD-8K) filter chips. Clicking a photo previews it on an empty workspace; keep or drop it from the notch. Kept photos are saved as <wallpaper dir>/kpopping/<Group>/<Idol>/<Idol>_<date>_<id>.jpg. Also adds a Wallpaper fit setting for skwd-wall (Auto shows portrait wallpapers whole on a blurred backdrop) and makes the picker reopen faster.
author: POSiTiiiV
permissions: Queries kpopping.com's public API (no login, no cookies) when you search in Kpopping mode

Downloads thumbnails (via kpopping.com's image resizer) and full-size photos (from its Cloudflare R2 bucket) into ~/.cache/ambxst/kpopping; thumbnails unused for 30 days and previews older than 7 days are deleted, except a preview that is still your wallpaper
Copies the photo you pick into <wallpaper dir>/kpopping/
Desktop previews close the dashboard, switch to an empty workspace and set the cached photo as your wallpaper (colours included) until you keep or drop it from the notch
Writes display.fillMode / display.backgroundMode in skwd-wall's ~/.config/skwd-wall-v2/config.json before each wallpaper change (the Wallpaper fit setting; 'Leave it to skwd-wall' turns this off)
